home.title: -60° Solo Helper
home.play1: Play a against Arka, the solo opponent.
home.play2: This application manages Arka's Action Cards, Arka's Milestone Cards and Arka's Tableau and guides you through the game and solo ruleset. It supports all difficulty levels.

difficultyLevel.title: Difficulty Level
difficultyLevel.actionCardsWithoutStar: no Action Cards without a star | {count} Action Card without a star | {count} Action Cards without a star

gameSetup.title: Game Setup
gameSetup.twoPlayerSetup: Follow the normal setup for a two player game. Also, complete the personal setup until step 12.
gameSetup.milestoneCards: Take 4 Milestone Cards at random. Choose 3 of them and place them above the Expert Plan. Place the fourth Milestone Card back in the box, as it won't be needed.
gameSetup.firstPlayer: You are the first player in round 1.

instructions.arkaArea: You do not need Arka's Tableau: the app manages her Expedition Path, Expedition Track, Rondel, Upgrades and Expert columns. Instead, reserve an area for Arka next to the board. Everything Arka gets is placed there: Explorers, Stations, Station Sites, the Experts she takes and the Cards she draws (face down).
instructions.arkaComponents: Choose a color for Arka. Place the 4 personal Station Sites and 5 Stations of this color in Arka's area. Take all Explorers of this color, place 2 of them back in the box and the others in Arka's area.
instructions.arkaMilestoneCards: Arka's Milestone Cards, scored from left to right. They are shown in the app, optionally place them in Arka's area:

ruleChanges.title: Managed by the App
ruleChanges.managedByApp: Arka's Action Cards, her Tableau and her Milestone scoring are managed by the app. You do not need Arka's Tableau, the Expedition Marker, Energy Marker, Milestone Tiles and Upgrades of Arka's color, nor the Starting Indicator.
ruleChanges.actionCardDeck: Arka's Action Card deck consists of all 9 Action Cards with one star and no Action Cards without a star. | Arka's Action Card deck consists of all 9 Action Cards with one star and {count} random Action Card without a star. | Arka's Action Card deck consists of all 9 Action Cards with one star and {count} random Action Cards without a star.
ruleChanges.arkaPhases: Arka does not perform a Preparation and a Planning Phase. She is only active during the Action Phase and scores Milestones at the end of the third, fifth and sixth round.
ruleChanges.meteorite: Arka ignores the Meteorite. She never places an Explorer on it and scores no victory points from it.

finalScoring.title: Final Scoring (VP)
finalScoring.arkaExpeditionTrack: 1 VP per step, plus 5 VP for the first space of the Expedition Path.
finalScoring.arkaProjectCards: Project Cards with Game End effect score the lower victory point value.
finalScoring.meteorite: Meteorite (at the -60.6° Meteorite you always take first place)

sideBar.starLimit: Expedition Level: stars Arka plays per round

build-station.title: Build a Station
build-station.text: Take a Station and a Station Site with exactly the value of Arka's Engineer icons +1. For a value of 1 to 3, you choose any available side of Arka's personal Station Sites with that value. For a value of 4 or more, take the top Station Site from the face-down pile with that value. Only if there are no more Station Sites with that value available, take the next lower one. Build next to the coldest Landscape adjacent to as many Landscapes as possible. In the event of a tie, you decide.

build-station-if-3-engineers.title: Building a Station if Arka has at least 3 Engineer icons
build-station-if-3-engineers.text: This action works just like "Build a Station", except it can only be carried out if Arka has at least 3 Engineer icons on her Tableau.
build-station-if-3-engineers.otherwise: Arka has fewer than 3 Engineer icons, so she does not build a Station. Otherwise:

take-expert.title: Take the upper-most available Expert from the left
take-expert.text: Take the upper-most available Expert from the left. If Arka takes a Pilot or Mechanic this way, place it in the column with the most Experts on her Tableau. In case of a tie, choose freely.
take-expert.pilotMechanicColumn: The app tracks Arka's Expert columns: for a Pilot or Mechanic it uses the column with the most Experts that is not full yet (5 placed Experts plus the printed one). On a tie, you choose the column.

take-engineer.title: Take the left-most Engineer
take-engineer.text: Take the left-most Engineer. If none is available, take a Mission Coordinator instead.

take-investor.title: Take the left-most Investor
take-investor.text: Take the left-most Investor. If none is available, take a Mission Coordinator instead.

take-radio-operator.title: Take the left-most Radio Operator
take-radio-operator.text: Take the left-most Radio Operator. If none is available, take a Mission Coordinator instead.

take-upgrade.title: Take an Upgrade
take-upgrade.text: Arka takes an Upgrade. Each Upgrade is worth 4 victory points at the end of the game. Arka's Upgrades are managed by the app.

explore-landscape.title: Explore the next Landscape
explore-landscape.text: Take an Explorer and explore the next Landscape (following the red marks). Arka does not gain a Radar Tile.
explore-landscape.noLandscapeLeft: If the last unexplored Landscape has been explored, take a random unused Landscape in the range of -62.1° to -63° and place it at the red mark of the Landscape just explored.

place-explorer-landscape.title: Place an Explorer on a Landscape
place-explorer-landscape.text: Take an Explorer and place it on the Landscape with the most available Action Spaces. In the event of a tie, place it on the coldest one. Prioritize choosing a Coin reward and then an Energy reward. Arka does not carry out the action and does not take a Placement Bonus. Arka ignores the Meteorite.

place-explorer-expert-action-tile.title: Place an Explorer on an Expert Action Tile
place-explorer-expert-action-tile.text: Take an Explorer and place it on an Expert Action Tile. Choose the space with the highest Coin reward. If all are occupied, choose the one with the highest Energy reward. In the event of a tie, choose the leftmost space. Arka does not carry out the action, but only occupies the action space.

milestone-special-action.title: Special action of Arka's next Milestone Card
milestone-special-action.text: Carry out the special action of Arka's next Milestone Card.

milestone-special-action-all.title: Special actions of all Arka's Milestone Cards that haven't been scored yet
milestone-special-action-all.text: Carry out the special actions of all Arka's Milestone Cards that haven't been scored yet.

draw-cards.title: Rondel: Draw Cards
draw-cards.text: Arka draws a number of Cards from the common deck equal to the number of her Investor icons. Place these Cards face down in Arka's area. The Cards do not trigger any effects. They are worth only the victory points shown during final scoring.

rules.expertAvailability: Like you, Arka can only take Experts that are available according to the Round Indicator: in the first round from the first three columns of the Expert Plan, in each following round from one additional column.
rules.expertPlacement: Place the Expert in Arka's area. The app tracks her Expert columns (see sidebar).
